title: Dorze Injera (Chencha)
community: Dorze people — master weavers of the Omo Valley
author: Mama Tigist

heritage.origin: Dorze people — around Chencha in the Omo Valley highlands
heritage.history: The Dorze people are famous across Ethiopia for two things: their extraordinary weaving skills (Dorze cotton cloth is among the finest in Ethiopia) and their injera made from the Dorze banana-leaf preserved enset mixed with teff. Dorze injera is significantly larger than standard injera — so large it is said one Dorze injera lasts three days as the outer edges are eaten while the centre remains fresh. The Dorze live in remarkable beehive-shaped bamboo houses that can be moved, and their food reflects both their ingenuity and their highland Omo Valley location.

desc: Dorze Injera — the famous giant injera of the Dorze people, made from teff with a proportion of enset starch. The Dorze injera is so large it is said to last three days — eaten from the edges inward. The master weavers' bread.
longDesc: Dorze injera is famous across Ethiopia for its size — made on a very large mitad, it is served folded and enough for a family meal. The addition of enset starch (from the false banana) gives it a distinctive chewiness.
ingredients: // Make as standard injera (ETH001) with 20% enset starch added
// Or: 2.5 cups teff flour + ½ cup enset/arrowroot starch
equipment: Very large mitad or large flat pan
steps: Mix teff flour and starch. Add water and starter.
Cook on the largest possible mitad — the bigger the injera the more authentic.
Cook one side only as per standard injera method.
chefTips: The Dorze injera is massive — use the largest available cooking surface.
commonMistakes: Standard size — misses the point of Dorze tradition.
cookingScience: See ETH001 for injera fermentation science.
storage: Keeps fresh 3 days at room temperature.
culturalNote: Dorze injera is a statement of abundance — the weaver people who create some of Ethiopia's finest cloth also create Ethiopia's largest injera. Their hospitality is expressed in size.
